The mechanism vocabulary is familiar as a family rather than as a paper: the trio of decision cost, principal competence cost and principal conflict cost is the standard taxonomy of the costs of collective ownership (Hansmann's Ownership of Enterprise); agent_conflict_cost is Jensen-Meckling agency cost; the split of what is owed into contractible control rights and discretionary residual rights is Grossman-Hart-Moore incomplete-contracts property rights; and purpose as a credible commitment that is cheap talk unless backed by governance is the Henderson-Van den Steen / Gartenberg line on purpose. So the ingredients were known to me; their assembly into this model, the definitions of A, B and pi_star, and the sensitivity pattern were not. My explanations were inferred from the mechanism descriptions and the reported indices, not recalled from a source. One qualification worth recording: knowing the literature families is not the same as knowing nothing — the incidence asymmetry between principal and agent costs is the kind of modelling move I would expect from that tradition, and the routing accounts I gave lean on that expectation.
